title: SpaceX IPO hot take: 🔥 "The numbers don't really pan out that much."
description:
@EinsteinofWallStreet SpaceX IPO hot take: 🔥 "The numbers don't really pan out that much."
Is the SpaceX IPO hype real or just noise? Wall Street veteran Peter Tuchman analyzes the financials behind SpaceX, questioning if the projected $300-$500 opening price matches the actual revenue data
